title: Distributed Coordination
reward: Learn when many sources may represent one campaign hypothesis.
knowledge: Correlate target similarity, timing, sequence and probe family across independent sources.
Subnet proximity is weak evidence unless behavior also correlates.
Rotating sources can lower per-source rate while preserving campaign-level structure.
Shared scanners, NAT and cloud fleets are alternative explanations.
Campaign confidence must retain conflicting evidence and source diversity.
challenge: Form a distributed-scan hypothesis without using subnet alone.
Name evidence that would weaken coordination confidence.
next_requires: Correlate behavior across sources without inventing a single actor.
